question: Indicate which of the following is the most frequent cause of liver transplantation in childhood:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Biliary atresia -> liver damage -> end-stage liver disease -> liver transplantation in childhood -> 90%
CHAIN: Primary type I hyperoxaluria -> kidney stones -> kidney damage -> oxalate deposition in the liver -> liver transplantation in childhood -> 80%
analysis: Biliary atresia is the most frequent cause of liver transplantation in childhood.
